cues: Three consequences follow, and they answer our cold open.
First, d zero and d ten ions are colourless: no d electron to promote, or no empty place to promote it to.
Zinc two plus is d ten, so zinc sulphate is colourless.
Copper two plus is d nine, with one vacancy, so it is blue.
